skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the theoretical foundations of social security law, including concepts, characteristics, and principles. Familiarity with specific legal provisions such as social insurance, health insurance, unemployment insurance, social benefits, and social assistance.
Ability to conduct independent research on social security laws and regulations.
Apply legal knowledge to solve practical social security issues.
Effective collaboration and teamwork in legal contexts.
Effective communication and presentation skills in legal settings.
Analytical and critical thinking in legal problem-solving.
Ability to prepare and deliver effective presentations on legal topics.
Understanding and application of methods for resolving social security disputes.
